verses.1: Thus said Jehovah: This is the list of your sins. You were sent away by those who bought you from me. Thus, in your sins, you were sold as slaves.
verses.2: Why have I come here? There is no one to call upon. No one to help me. My hands are too weak to save anyone. If I don’t have the strength to save them, then in my anger, I will destroy the seas. I will make rivers flow from the deserts. Their fish will come from nowhere, and they will die in the wilderness.
verses.3: Let the heavens be filled with light and joy, and let they be covered with glory.
verses.4: Elohim of Yehovah has given me the ability to know what is wrong. He will speak to me in the morning, and I will hear His words.
verses.5: Adonai Yehovah, you have opened my ears; but I still do not listen. I have not been tested yet.
verses.6: I have been given to the rulers and to those who live in darkness. My face has not been hidden from their eyes.
verses.7: And the Lord of Yehovah will help me. Therefore, I will not be afraid. I will cover my face like a dreamer, and I will know that I am not alone.
verses.8: The righteous ones will not fight against me. They will stand together with me. The man who judges will come to me.
verses.9: May the priests of Jehovah help me. Who will save me from this situation? They all will be destroyed; they will be eaten by worms.
verses.10: Who among you will fear Jehovah, who hears the voice of his servant who has gone astray and has no one to rely on? Who can trust in Jehovah’s name and be saved by His grace?
verses.11: May you all be like flames of fire, burning away all the evil and suffering in your homes. May it be a source of comfort for you. It was done by me, and it will bring you peace.
